details:
This update for flatpak fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-90616: missing symlink protection allows a malicious sandboxed app to obtain arbitrary read and write access
  to files on the host (bsc#1280236).
- CVE-2026-92162: path traversal via unvalidated `arch` parameter in `DeployAppstream` (bsc#1282514).
- CVE-2026-96275: arbitrary write access as root via extra-data extraction (bsc#1282515).
- CVE-2026-96276: arbitrary write in host context via `flatpak build-init` (bsc#1282516).
- CVE-2026-96280: buffer overflow in OCI delta stream path names (bsc#1282518).
- CVE-2026-96281: unprivileged active user can bypass anti-downgrade checks for system apps/runtimes (bsc#1282519).
- CVE-2026-96282: extension metadata path traversal file existence oracle (bsc#1282520).
- CVE-2026-96807: fixed-filename writes to arbitrary locations via symlink attack on `.ld.so` (bsc#1282523).
- CVE-2026-96808: `revokefs` symlink path traversal allows local privilege escalation via commit tampering
  (bsc#1282524).

Changes for flatpak:

- Update to version 1.16.6 (jsc#PED-17048):
 + Fix file descriptor leaks affecting Chromium-based browsers.
 + Fix installing extra-data without a runtime, including openh264.
 + Fix unusable sandbox-expose paths affecting Epiphany.
 + Fix installed tests and handling of file descriptor arguments.
- Changes from version 1.16.5:
 + Fix regressions from the sandbox escape security fix affecting
 browsers, browser-based apps and Steam.
 + Expand test coverage of flatpak-run features used by the portal.
- Changes from version 1.16.4:
 + Prevent arbitrary file reads in the system-helper context
 (GHSA-2fxp-43j9-pwvc).
 + Prevent orphaning cross-user pull operations (GHSA-89xm-3m96-w3jg).
- Changes from version 1.16.3:
 + Be selective about mapping font-dirs.xml in flatpak build.
- Changes from version 1.16.2:
 + Support reinstalling bundle installations and Intel Xe VA-API.
 + Add cancellation support for curl downloads.
 + Fix font configuration, mask and pin configuration reloads,
 unintended home directory access, flatpak kill, OCI support,
 memory leaks and crashes.
- Changes from version 1.16.1:
 + Allow updating existing apps under parental controls by default.
 + Use instance IDs for systemd scopes and include /dev/udmabuf
 with --device=dri.
 + Speed up prune --dry-run and permission-reset.
 + Support TLS certificates in /etc/containers/certs.d for OCI.
 + Fix portal crashes, sandbox environment handling, accessibility
 bus discovery, error reporting and shell completion.
 + Update documentation and translations.
